readiness_metadata.note: M26-B implements domain contracts, port interfaces, versioned schemas, and deterministic codecs. No adapters or runtime.

domain_contracts.description: Pure platform-independent value objects with invariants. 212 tests exercise construction, validation, and boundaries.
domain_contracts.notes: All domain objects reject invalid state at construction. No vendor SDK imports.

port_interfaces.description: Abstract Protocol interfaces for hardware, telemetry, authorization, storage, audit, clock, factory
port_interfaces.notes: 8 port interfaces defined. All importable without vendor SDKs.

versioned_schemas.description: 13 versioned JSON Schema documents (Draft 2020-12) with stable URN identifiers. All 13 pass metaschema validation. All local $ref values resolve.
versioned_schemas.notes: Full Draft 2020-12 validation implemented via jsonschema 4.26.0.

deterministic_codecs.description: Explicit encode/decode functions with canonical JSON, round-trip tested. NaN/Inf rejected. Stable enum strings.
deterministic_codecs.notes: Canonical digest test vectors verified. List-order sensitivity documented.

architecture_enforcement.description: Tests verify no forbidden imports, no import-time side effects (socket, subprocess, sleep, env vars)
architecture_enforcement.notes: Import-side-effect instrumentation confirms zero network/FS/process side effects.
